mechanics: Armor / Heavy Armor / Ultra Heavy Armor
description: When an opposing Magic or Spirit effect targets an armor-protected spirit for destruction/bounce, isImmune intercepts before effect execution.
Clash requires the opponent to block if able (mustBlockIfAble). If attacker has Leap, ground spirits cannot block, so mustBlockIfAble applies only to spirits with Flying.
If both attacker and blocker are destroyed by mutual BP comparison, Curse onBattleEnd recognizes the blocker has already exited the field and avoids double-kill errors.
Consecutive Blade forces simultaneous battle against 2 opposing spirits. Showdown isolates a 1v1 battle, overriding multi-target battle declarations.
Wave Crush fixes the spirit symbol to zero. Additive symbol grants (+1 Red symbol) cannot override fixed-to-zero restriction per official Bandai priority hierarchy.
Rebirth cards flip between Face A and Face B. getActiveKeywords evaluates stack.currentFace and stack.isFlipped to strictly gate Face A vs Face B keywords.
Infinite Blade targets an opposing spirit/ultimate. Opposing units with CANNOT_BE_ATTACKED continuous restriction cannot be selected as combat targets.
When a Burst declares activation, Trigger Counter activates during the Burst declaration window before the Burst effect resolves.
